messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: runtime-serving: spike in p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate for canary pool 'canary-east-2'. Alerting oncall.

mario: Oncall here, looking. I see a throughput drop and a bunch of kernel-fallback logs in the canary hosts.

tara: saw the same in dashboards — sudden switch to fallback kernels ~ 3m after deploy. batch size also dropping to 1-2 frequently.

ops_sre: paging — preflight: rolled out canary 5m ago (deploy-bot: deploy/2026-03-17T10:02Z). Could be a kernel selector regression.

mario: running quick grep: 
```
grep -i "kernel_fallback" /var/log/runtime/*.log | tail -n 20
```
lots of lines with "kselector: unable to find optimized kernel, falling back"

eve: also seeing saturation on intra-node queues, batcher logs showing frequent flushes: `flush_reason=evict` and `batch_size=1`.

support_lead: any customer impact? Support reports two enterprise customers seeing 10-20% higher latencies and occasional 502s. Shipping metrics show increased token latency.

mario: impact seems limited to canary pool but we route a small percent of prod traffic there. Recommend kill-switch the featureflip for new model-routing to canary, and then rollback the canary deploy if that doesn't immediately stabilize.

tara: agreed. We should flip FF first (fast). If that doesn't work, rollback to previous runtime revision.

deploy-bot: runbook suggestion: `ffctl set routing.canary.enabled false --actor=mario --reason="canary latency regression"`

mario: running FF toggle now.

mario: `ffctl set routing.canary.enabled false` -> API OK, traffic shift initiated. Observing metrics...

ops_sre: p50 dropping back down a bit, p95 still elevated. 5xx rate trending down but not back to baseline yet.

eve: kernel fallback logs still appearing on a few hosts. might be old processes that need restart.

mario: timebox 10m for FF to take effect. If no full recovery, we'll rollback the canary deploy.

support_lead: I've told affected customers we're investigating and have started a temporary traffic-shift. No escalations yet.

(6m later)

ops_sre: FF helped, 5xx reduced by ~60%, p50 normal, p95 still ~1.8x pre-deploy on a subset.

mario: initiating rollback of the canary revision to previous artifact. Command: 
```
deploy-bot rollback --env=prod --pool=canary-east-2 --target-revision=rev-2026-03-16-1530
```
deploy-bot: rollback started, streaming events to #deploys.

(rollback completes)

ops_sre: rollback finished. Kernel-fallback logs dropped to background rate, batcher sizes stabilized to baseline. Metrics look healthy.

mario: flipping FF back to allow normal routing now. `ffctl set routing.canary.enabled true` (restore).

support_lead: contacting the two impacted customers with ETA and summary. No loss of data, transient latency issues only.

mario: creating incident ticket (INC-2026-0317-03) and will hand off to tara for postmortem and root cause analysis. Actions: collect full kernel selector logs, batcher flush traces, and deploy artifact diffs.

tara: taking handoff. next_oncall: you're on for the next 12h, please monitor the canary pools and watch for re-occurrence. I'll start the postmortem draft.

next_oncall: ack, I'll monitor and follow up on RCA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared.
